scope: Actual local signed app, process/socket verification and native renderer theme lifecycle. No automated native UI input or screenshot capture.

results.test: signed app version and real process/socket ownership
wrong build rejected by live application probe
changed creation time rejected by live process probe
repeated Start reuses the verified managed window
running loader matches current installed source hash
Pause removes all theme nodes and stylesheet
Stop exits only the loader and preserves the managed app
Resume restarts the loader on the same managed window
ordinary client processes remain alive with the same identity

limitations: Native screenshot/visual review requires the user; the computer-use tool prohibits controlling Codex.
No outgoing chat request or authenticated Chat conversation was generated by these tests.
All six wallpaper changes and Work request/submitting shells are additionally covered by headless fixtures.
note: Runtime and launcher match the source contribution. This completed run predates the later optional exit probes; no SIGTERM/SIGKILL acceptance is claimed.
